title: 報名頁多語介面 — i18n 完整支援 (en/zh-hk/zh-cn)
content: Enroll wizard 目前硬編碼部分中文標籤與錯誤訊息。本卡片將 enroll 流程所有 UI 文字遷移至 dictionary 系統，支援三語，包括表單欄位標籤、驗證錯誤訊息、步驟導航、付款說明、確認頁文案。

findings: Enroll wizard page exists at src/app/[locale]/courses/[slug]/enroll/page.tsx with real API integration (EN-002 done)
Uses EnrollmentWizard component — likely has hardcoded Chinese labels
Dictionary types need an EnrollViewDict or similar for enroll-related keys
evidence.residual: Scope is UI text only — no behavioral or API changes.

acceptance: Add enroll-related dict keys to dictionaries/en.json, zh-hk.json, zh-cn.json and types.ts
Replace all hardcoded strings in EnrollmentWizard and enroll page with dict lookups
Cover: form labels (name, email, phone, idDocNumber), step titles, validation error messages, payment method descriptions, fee display, submit button, confirmation page text
Locale switching (en ↔ zh-hk ↔ zh-cn) re-renders all enroll page text correctly
No hardcoded strings remain in the enroll page/component files
verification: Visit /en/courses/{slug}/enroll → all text in English. Switch to /zh-hk/courses/{slug}/enroll → all text in Traditional Chinese. Switch to /zh-cn/courses/{slug}/enroll → all text in Simplified Chinese. No English or Chinese text leaks across locales.
